task: GitHub issue #40: status lifecycle — _cmd_status must answer 'is my run stuck/dead/done' by reading RUN_FINISHED, rendering status: running|succeeded|failed[:error], listing all IN_PROGRESS tasks in concurrent mode, and hinting tahoe resume for non-terminal runs

acceptance.criterion: Failed run shows failed marker + error
acceptance.evidence: tests/test_status.py::test_status_failed_run_shows_failed_marker_and_error asserts 'failed' and 'kaput' in human output; ::test_status_failed_run_json_carries_error asserts data['status']=='failed' and data['error'] contains 'kaput'

acceptance.criterion: Concurrent run lists every IN_PROGRESS task
acceptance.evidence: tests/test_status.py::test_status_concurrent_run_lists_all_in_progress_tasks asserts 'step.first' and 'step.second' in output; ::test_status_concurrent_run_json_lists_all_in_progress asserts 2 in_progress_tasks with task-1 and task-2

acceptance.criterion: Crashed (non-terminal) run renders distinctly from finished
acceptance.evidence: tests/test_status.py::test_status_crashed_run_shows_running_not_succeeded asserts 'running' in output and 'succeeded' not in output; ::test_status_crashed_run_hints_resume asserts 'resume' in output; ::test_status_crashed_run_json_is_running_with_resume_hint asserts status=='running', hint=='tahoe resume'
All JSON tests assert: status (from RUN_FINISHED), in_progress_tasks (list of {id, text}), error (from failed RUN_FINISHED or null), hint ('tahoe resume' for non-terminal, null otherwise)
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q -> 875 passed in 21.62s (864 baseline unmodified + 11 new)
